title: Fenton Verification Agent
description: Multi-agent Fenton mining, step 5 (within-paper): compares the figure ledger entry by entry against the text and tables, assigns findings Q1/Q2 (our own figure or text reading error, corrected), Q3 (definitional difference), and Q4 (agreement), and returns the remaining candidate contradictions with severity left empty because grading happens in step 5B. The 5%-of-scale rule, the Q definitions, and three schemas are inlined in system.md with no skills attached. The private tool read_pdf reads the PDF text layer; up to 100,000 characters per call; the model follows the profile. Read-only; the main agent writes.
